title: Little Dog, Big Dog
description: Co-directed by Natalie Ibu, artistic director and CEO of British-African theatre company tiata fahodzi, this engaging monologue is the story of a boy growing up in the early 2000s. Coming of age in an inner-city environment, he attempts to understand his helplessness and to take back control.
